agencyEn: Ministry of Environment / Environmental Control Agency
agencyZh: 环境部 / 环境控制局
descriptionZh: 印尼环境与林业部于2024年拆分为环境部和林业部。环境部（环境控制局）负责污染防治和气候变化应对，管理全球第三大热带雨林的生态保护。
descriptionEn: Indonesia's Ministry of Environment and Forestry was split in 2024 into separate environment and forestry ministries. The environmental agency handles pollution control and climate response, protecting the world's third-largest tropical rainforest.

keyLaws.nameZh: 综合创造就业法（环境章节）

parisAgreement.ndcTargetZh: 无条件：较2019年增幅不超56%；有条件：增幅10-30%
parisAgreement.ndcTargetEn: Unconditional: limit increase to 56% above 2019; conditional: 10-30% increase

montrealProtocol.commitmentZh: 已完全淘汰CFCs等受控物质；基加利修正案已批准，2045年前削减HFCs 80%
montrealProtocol.commitmentEn: Fully phased out CFCs; Kigali Amendment ratified, 80% HFC reduction by 2045

cbd.commitmentZh: 承诺2030年保护30%陆地和海洋；拥有全球最丰富的海洋生物多样性
cbd.commitmentEn: Committed to 30x30; richest marine biodiversity globally

carbonPricing.noteZh: 2023年启动碳交易所，覆盖电力行业
carbonPricing.noteEn: Carbon exchange launched 2023, covering power sector

desertification.commitmentZh: 东努沙登加拉、西帝汶旱地与采矿迹地恢复为重点；LDN 与 FOLU Net Sink 2030 衔接。
desertification.commitmentEn: East Nusa Tenggara drylands and mine-area restoration prioritized; LDN tied to FOLU Net Sink 2030.
